key_concepts: Position-time graph shapes indicate rest, constant velocity, speeding up, or slowing down
The slope of a displacement-time graph gives velocity
Flat sections on displacement-time graphs mean the object is not moving
Changing slope on displacement-time graphs indicates acceleration
Ticker tape dot spacing represents distance traveled in equal time intervals
Equal ticker tape dot spacing indicates constant velocity; increasing spacing indicates ac
Velocity-time graphs can represent ticker tape motion
A wave is a disturbance in a medium that carries energy away from the source
Waves carry energy but not particles of the medium
Greater tapping force produces higher amplitude waves, and amplitude determines wave energ
Transverse wave parts include crest, trough, line of origin, wavelength, and amplitude
Crest is the highest point, trough is the lowest point, amplitude is maximum displacement
